description: Run the feature as a user would, step by step, capturing the state before each step and the final state, with the cursor path. Write each instruction in plain user language ("Pick a customer"). Mark steps a short video can drop as skippable, and the step whose result is the payoff.

hide.description: CSS selectors to leave out of every state (cookie banners, personal widgets), as capture_screen takes them

result.description: What happens next, in plain words

target.description: How to find an element: prefer role+name, then text, then selector.

name.description: Accessible name (with role) or a form label (alone)

selector.description: CSS selector, last resort. In a demo step, "@x,y" is a point in the window (CSS px; points on a phone) for a canvas with nothing to target

name: capture_flow
title: Capture a flow
